Our seminar team introduces this month's recommended web seminars.

【Title】
Accounting Fundamentals for Accounting Staff — Reading Financial Statements

【Instructor】
Hiroki Imazeki (Imazeki Hiroki)
Certified Tax Accountant

【Overview】
A comprehensive course covering accounting practice from journal entries and ledgers through settlement and how to read financial statements. You'll develop the ability to understand financial condition and business performance from the numbers, and answer the company president's questions with confidence. Refresh your knowledge of accounting fundamentals and improve the quality of your work! (Recorded: June 9, 2026) (Available until: September 30, 2026) (71 minutes)

※ Viewing web seminars is a member benefit of Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
Member businesses wishing to receive login ID and password for viewing should contact their assigned staff member.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2640/
